src: implicit trace head initialized at the centered green output marker
path: read the red input glyphs left to right; a vertical glyph advances two rows in the same column, and a 2x2 elbow advances one row while stepping to the bottom cell not under the entry cell
trajectory: paint the decoded vertical or horizontal red segment for each glyph
transform: build a black output canvas with the green marker at top center; do not copy the input strip itself
grid_shape: height is one marker row plus decoded path rows; width is input_width/2 + 1
symbol_instructions: each red glyph's single top cell is the entry; its bottom row defines the segment to paint and the next trace-head column
